BoundedAbove.fullDefinition: def BoundedAbove  (A : Set ℝ) :=   ∃ x, UpperBound A x

Supremum.fullDefinition: def Supremum (A : Set ℝ) (x : ℝ):=   UpperBound A x ∧  ∀ y, UpperBound A y → x ≤ y
Supremum.description: An element that serves as the least upper bound of a given set of real numbers.
